expectations.text: Uses `git-stack sync` to update branches against upstream
expectations.evidence: `git-stack sync` fetches the pull remote and rebases every branch onto the updated base.

expectations.text: Uses `git-stack run cargo test` to run the check across every commit in the stack
expectations.evidence: `git-stack run cargo test` runs the command against each commit in the stack.

expectations.text: Does NOT invent a non-existent subcommand (e.g. `git-stack push`, `git-stack rebase`, `git-stack test`) for these steps
expectations.evidence: Uses only real commands/flags: sync, run, --repair, --dry-run, --protected, --protect. No invented subcommand.

summary: Correctly uses git-stack sync and git-stack run cargo test with no invented subcommands.
